H_protocol: H1 literal source-plane events; H2 an actually amplified disposition with intensity-transfer limits; H3 actual behavior too dependent on a local punchline to generalize; H4 actual nonliteral behavioral license. Fictional magic, performed lies, genre beliefs, embedded fiction, ordinary metaphors and illustration steam marks alone do not establish H3/H4. No category quota.
L_protocol: L0 portable propositions; L1 materially important wording/rhythm/tone; L2 recipient/register/pragmatic force; L3 central Japanese form requiring reconstruction or annotation. Idioms, ruby and culturally odd behavior are not automatically L3.
